part.text: The bug: in src/diff/props.js:58, for `onFocusIn`, the lowercased name `onfocusin` isn't a DOM handler property, so Preact falls back to `patch.name.slice(2)` = `FocusIn`, registering a listener for the nonexistent `FocusIn` event. `focusin`/`focusout` need the lowercased name even though no `onfocusin` property exists on elements.

part.text:
Fixed in src/diff/props.js:57-70. The event-name casing inference now lowercases the prop name for `onfocusin`/`onfocusout` even though those handler properties don't exist on DOM elements, so `onFocusIn`/`onFocusOut` register `focusin`/`focusout` listeners instead of the nonexistent `FocusIn`/`FocusOut` events.

Validation: the new "should support camel-case focus event names" test passes, and the full suites pass (1145 karma browser tests, 29 mocha tests, eslint clean).
